updates.title: OBBBA Implementation Guidance Released
updates.summary: IRS actively clarifying OBBBA (One Big Beautiful Bill Act) provisions affecting businesses. Multiple CPE webinars and guidance documents being issued. Key areas: business deductions, opportunity zones, and compliance.
updates.action: Review OBBBA changes affecting your business structure, deductions, and reporting; consult with CPA on implementation timeline

updates.title: QOZ Transition Guidance (IRS Notice 2026-40)
updates.summary: IRS issued Notice 2026-40 providing transitional guidance for Qualified Opportunity Zone investments under new OBBBA rules. Changes affect real estate investment timing and structure.
updates.action: If considering QOZ investments, review new guidance on compliance and timeline requirements; assess impact on planned real estate deals

updates.title: MA Division of Banks Q2 2026 Enforcement
updates.summary: Division of Banks released Q2 2026 enforcement bulletin. Updates to small loans, truth-in-lending, and mortgage licensing regulations. Review for hard money lending compliance.
updates.action: For hard money lending business: review enforcement bulletin for compliance gaps; audit recent lending documentation against updated regulations

updates.title: Section 179 Deduction Limit Confirmed for 2026
updates.summary: IRS confirmed Section 179 equipment deduction limit remains at $2.5 million for tax year 2026. Applies to business equipment, vehicles, and property used in real estate and carwash operations.
updates.action: Plan equipment purchases for businesses before year-end; confirm Section 179 eligibility for carwash equipment and real estate improvements
